hook: *61,059* Karnataka voter-deletion forms filed by officials themselves, and *none* give a reason
tldr: At least 61,059 Form 7 applications to delete names from Karnataka's rolls were filed by election officials, auto-generated with their digital signatures, and none state a reason, which the rules require. The same machinery objects to voters and decides on them.

beats.what: EROs say the system auto-generated forms when voters couldn't be reached during hearings and marked them 'ineligible'.
beats.why: SIR already deleted over 1.07 crore names from Karnataka's draft roll. In Hyderabad, protesters at Dharna Chowk on Sunday demanded CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal.
beats.care: Check your name on the voter roll at voters.eci.gov.in before the final list. If you've moved, update your address.

cards.body: Under the 1960 Registration of Electors Rules, an objection without a stated reason is liable to be rejected.

viz.l: deletion forms with no reason given
